applicability.scope_note: This is a candidate applicability profile. It does not activate generic v17 combat. Until independent approval and versioned cutover, the active combat-contract scope remains Phase 1B v16. The inherited adjacent NPC decision rows are retained as out-of-scope data references and are not activated by this profile.

included_clauses.rule: Single attempted action connects to one check and its consequence; defines the causal unit.
Use only current attack-relevant facts (participants, readiness, visibility, distance, equipment, body and witnesses); this does not import session setup.
Defines attack-check formula and only melee attribute/skill selection; ranged, grapple, social, stealth and other bases are outside this profile.
Defines the target defense value consumed by this attack.
Defines only already-current active-defense modifiers and their limits; no separate defense action is run.
Defines this check result and its direct outcome bands.
Defines the attack harm calculation.
Defines weapon danger and directly relevant held-item facts.
Defines target vulnerability used in the harm calculation.
Defines armor mitigation and coverage against this attack threat.
Defines direct health/body consequence; authoritative body transition remains with body-state owner.
Defines current injury, fear or fatigue modifiers when present in authoritative state.
Defines attack reach/distance compatibility and its direct modifier.
Defines the current ready weapon/hands facts only; drawing or re-equipping is a separate action.
Defines modifier cap and dominant-modifier selection for the check.

Accepts only direct mechanical prohibitions: no automatic success or invented gear/state, no negating physics, unbounded modifiers, invalid armor coverage, unsupported death, or repetitive unchanged attacks.
Recaps the same single-action attack mechanics; post-fight energy formula at line 1146 is excluded.
Keeps attack/formula ownership and its non-NPC decision owner boundaries; exchange proposal at line 317 and decision-signal descriptors at line 321 are excluded.
Keeps authoritative body state and application with body-state after combat-health produces a harm package.
Defines a technical step as one immediate code-owned action; only the attack action is in this profile.
Defines inputs used to construct one executable step; this profile covers attack mechanics, not intent/session lifecycle.
Requires approved generic profiles and rules out per-NPC scenario handlers.
Requires an approved exact duration for a time-bearing step and preserves the global-clock owner; this profile does not define exchange ordering.
Defines check request, check resolution, combat result/harm package and application of a body event, ending before threshold crossing and signal pipeline.
Keeps a single shared RNG/check owner for player and NPC attacks.
Separates combat harm semantics from the authoritative body-state transition.

excluded_clauses.rule: Combat §22 weight/load calculations and adjacent non-weapon access text do not become attack-step mechanics.
Multi-participant batches, pressure and actor ordering are outside one step.
Social aftermath and NPC reaction/decision behavior are owned elsewhere.
Fight teardown, treatment, stamina follow-ups and delayed post-fight effects are not direct attack mechanics.
Ranged, grapple, social, stealth and non-melee action bases in combat §4 are excluded from this melee-only applicability slice.
Incapacity/death rules and timer progression are downstream body-state consequences, not attack-step mechanics.
Post-fight energy, fatigue, load cost and satiety changes are follow-up mechanics, not direct attack effects.
The remaining §31 prohibitions concern NPC agency, witnesses/law, healing/narration, item generation or social consequences, outside direct attack mechanics.
The summary line for post-fight energy expenditure is excluded from the direct attack recap.
The §5.1 exchange proposal and decision-signal descriptors are excluded; this profile covers one attack step.
Body thresholds in §39.3 are excluded as an authoring field outside this attack-step applicability decision.
Combat start, trigger/session activation, persisted lifecycle and current exchange boundary do not transfer from v16.
The target session/intent/exchange runtime flow and its boundary are outside this single attack-step profile.
Trigger vocabulary/evaluation, perception signals, NPC decision pipeline, body-threshold cross-triggering and multi-NPC decision batches are excluded.
